tagline: Fast, open-source platform for Minecraft mods, plugins, shaders, and modpacks
description: Modrinth is a modern, open-source platform for publishing and discovering Minecraft mods, plugins, shaders, resource packs, data packs, and modpacks with creator-friendly monetization.
features: Fast web interface with version and loader filtering
Supports Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Quilt, Paper, Purpur, and more
Open-source codebase and developer-friendly public API
Official Modrinth App and wide third-party launcher support
